# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 20 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Benjamin Strikes Down Pharaoh's Son

---

**1** During the night, Pharaoh's son came with five hundred armed men to the house of Pentephres to kill him and his wife and to take Aseneth.

**2** Benjamin was sitting at the gate of the house and saw the men approaching. He cried out to his brothers Simeon and Levi: 'Behold, many armed men are coming to the gate in the night!'

**3** Simeon, Levi, and all the brothers rushed to the gate, and Levi said: 'Do not be afraid — the Lord God is with us and will fight for us.'

**4** Simeon said: 'I will take my sword and kill them all.' But Levi said: 'We shall not do that. Let us call upon the name of the Lord, and he will deliver us.'

**5** Levi prayed to the Lord and the Lord heard him. And behold, the swords fell from the hands of all five hundred men, and they were struck with blindness.

**6** Benjamin ran to Pharaoh's son, struck him with his right hand, knocked him from his horse, seized his sword, and struck him on the neck with it — but did not kill him.

**7** Aseneth called out to Benjamin from the window: 'Do not kill him, Benjamin my brother! A man who worships God must not render evil for evil.' Benjamin spared him.

**8** The sons of Dan and Gad saw what had happened and were afraid, and fled and hid themselves.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
